in_sanskrit.name: विष्वनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विश्व (Visva) - universe, नाथ (Natha) - protector, controller. So, Bishwanath means 'Lord of the Universe'.

in_hindi.name: विष्वनाथ
in_hindi.meaning: विश्व (Visva) - विज्ञान (Vijnana) - विश्वास (Vishvas) - universe, नाथ (Natha) - परिशद (Parishad) - प्रशासक (Prashasak) - परिकर्ता (Parikarta) - protector, controller, servant. So, Bishwanath means 'Lord of the Universe'.

in_tamil.name: விஷ்வநாத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஷ் (Viṣ) - universe, நாத் (Natha) - நல்ல விஷயம் (Nalla Visayam) - good thing, good quality, அரியவர் (Ariyan) - noble, good person. So, Bishwanath means 'Lord of the good universe' or 'Lord of the good quality universe'.

in_telugu.name: విష్శనాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: విష్ (Viṣ) - యోజనము (Yojanamu) - universe, నాథ (Natha) - దేశపై (deshpai) - ruler, master, యూపెరుణ్ణముదేశపై (Yupurnamudheshpai) - Lord of the universe.

in_marathi.name: Bishwanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bishwanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bishwa ( Universe ) + Nath ( Lord ). The name Bishwanath is a revered name in Hindu mythology, representing the supreme lord of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Bishwanath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bishwanath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bishwa ( Universe ) + Nath ( Lord ). The name Bishwanath is a revered name in Hindu mythology, representing the supreme lord of the universe.
